take.title_zh: 模型軍備競賽白熱化，設計工具站上前線
take.title_en: The Model Arms Race Heats Up, Design Tools Ride the Wave
take.body_zh:
本週 AI 戰場異常擁擠：Google DeepMind 推出 Gemini 3.6 Flash 搶佔即時互動場景，Moonshot AI 的 Kimi K3 以 2.8 兆參數規模挑戰全球前段班，OpenAI 也端出 GPT-5.6 三線產品戰略。對設計師而言，重點不是誰跑分最高，而是這些模型如何被包進 Figma 這類日常工具裡。

Figma 近期更新正說明這個轉向：從文字生成版面、智慧搜尋到可串接 GitHub、Slack 的 Agent 模式，AI 已從「另開視窗問答」變成嵌入工作流程的預設功能。設計師與 PM 接下來要練的技能，可能不是提示詞技巧，而是判斷何時該讓 AI 自動決策、何時該收回主導權。
take.body_en:
This week's AI landscape got crowded fast: Google DeepMind shipped Gemini 3.6 Flash for low-latency, real-time use cases, Moonshot AI's 2.8-trillion-parameter Kimi K3 muscled into the global top tier, and OpenAI rolled out a three-tier GPT-5.6 lineup. For designers, the real story isn't benchmark scores — it's how these models get packaged into everyday tools like Figma.

Figma's own updates make the shift concrete: text-to-layout generation, smart search, and an Agent mode that connects to GitHub and Slack mean AI is no longer a separate chat window but a default part of the workflow. The skill worth building now may be less about prompting and more about knowing when to let AI decide — and when to take the wheel back.

articles.title_zh: Google DeepMind 推出 Gemini 3.6 Flash，主打即時互動與代理應用
articles.title_en: Google DeepMind Ships Gemini 3.6 Flash for Real-Time, Agentic Use
articles.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 於 7 月 21 日推出 Gemini 3.6 Flash，是目前最新的前沿模型更新，強調更快推論速度與更低延遲，鎖定即時互動與代理型應用場景。此次更新延續 Gemini 系列在多模態理解上的優勢，也被視為回應 OpenAI GPT-5.6 與 Moonshot Kimi K3 的關鍵一步，顯示大型模型軍備競賽持續加速。
articles.summary_en: Google DeepMind released Gemini 3.6 Flash on July 21, its latest frontier model update, emphasizing faster inference and lower latency for real-time and agentic applications. The release extends Gemini's multimodal strengths and is widely read as a direct response to OpenAI's GPT-5.6 lineup and Moonshot AI's Kimi K3, underscoring how fast the frontier-model race keeps accelerating.
articles.take_zh: Flash 系列一路都在賭「便宜又夠快」這條路線，對需要即時回饋的設計協作工具（如即時共編、AI 建議）會是直接受益者。
articles.take_en: The Flash line keeps betting on cheap-and-fast over max capability — a direct win for design tools needing real-time feedback, like live co-editing or inline AI suggestions.

articles.title_zh: Moonshot AI 發表 Kimi K3，2.8 兆參數挑戰全球前段班
articles.title_en: Moonshot AI Unveils Kimi K3, a 2.8T-Parameter Contender for the Global Top Tier
articles.summary_zh: 中國新創 Moonshot AI 發表 Kimi K3，參數規模達 2.8 兆，支援百萬 token 上下文與原生視覺理解，在 Artificial Analysis 排行榜上擠進全球前四。模型權重預計 7 月 27 日開源釋出，API 定價為每百萬 token 輸入 3 美元、輸出 15 美元，被視為中國開源陣營追趕歐美前沿模型的最新指標。
articles.summary_en: Chinese startup Moonshot AI unveiled Kimi K3, a 2.8-trillion-parameter model with million-token context and native vision support, landing around #4 globally on the Artificial Analysis leaderboard. Open weights are due July 27, with API pricing at $3/$15 per million input/output tokens — another sign of Chinese open-source labs closing the gap with Western frontier models.
articles.take_zh: 百萬 token 上下文加原生視覺，代表這類模型很快能直接吃下整份設計稿或長版規格文件，對設計流程的衝擊可能比參數規模本身更大。
articles.take_en: Million-token context plus native vision means models like this can soon ingest a full design file or spec doc directly — arguably a bigger deal for design workflows than the parameter count itself.

articles.title_zh: OpenAI 推出 GPT-5.6 三線產品：Sol、Terra、Luna
articles.title_en: OpenAI Launches Three-Tier GPT-5.6 Lineup: Sol, Terra, Luna
articles.summary_zh: OpenAI 於 7 月中旬推出 GPT-5.6，一次以三種型號 Sol、Terra、Luna 分層布局，分別對應不同運算成本與能力需求，取代單一旗艦模型的發布模式。此舉呼應近期 Anthropic、Google 等對手皆採分層策略，反映前沿模型市場逐漸從「單一最強模型」轉向依場景需求分眾。
articles.summary_en: OpenAI released GPT-5.6 as a tiered lineup — Sol, Terra, and Luna — each targeting different cost and capability needs, replacing the single-flagship release pattern. The move mirrors similar tiering from Anthropic and Google, signaling the frontier-model market is shifting from a single "best model" race toward use-case-segmented offerings.
articles.take_zh: 分層產品線代表 API 選型會變成日常工作，PM 與設計師恐怕都得多學一項技能：依任務挑對模型，而不是預設用最貴那個。
articles.take_en: Tiered lineups mean picking the right model per task becomes routine work — one more skill PMs and designers will need, instead of defaulting to the priciest option.

articles.title_zh: Meta 推出百萬 token 代理模型 Muse Spark 1.1
articles.title_en: Meta Ships Muse Spark 1.1, a Million-Token Agentic Model
articles.summary_zh: Meta AI 發表 Muse Spark 1.1，支援百萬 token 上下文並強化代理式（agentic）任務執行能力，鎖定需要長時間規劃與多步驟操作的應用場景。此舉延續 Meta 近期把重心從純聊天模型轉向可自主完成任務的代理系統，與 OpenAI、Google 在代理型 AI 上的競爭同步升溫。
articles.summary_en: Meta AI released Muse Spark 1.1, featuring million-token context and stronger agentic task execution aimed at applications needing long-horizon planning and multi-step actions. The release continues Meta's pivot from chat-focused models toward autonomous task-completing agents, tracking the broader industry race toward agentic AI alongside OpenAI and Google.
articles.take_zh: 代理型模型的重點正在從「回答問題」轉向「代為執行」，設計師若還沒開始測試 agent 能不能接手重複性強的產出流程，現在是時候了。
articles.take_en: Agentic models are shifting from answering questions to executing tasks outright — worth testing now whether an agent can take over your team's repetitive production work.

articles.title_zh: 2026 年 Figma AI 全功能盤點：能做什麼、還做不到什麼
articles.title_en: Figma AI in 2026: Everything It Can Do — and What It Still Can't
articles.summary_zh: 這篇整理盤點 2026 年 Figma AI 的完整功能：文字生成版面、依專案脈絡建議元件、自動優化設計系統、去背與擴圖等影像編輯，以及可用截圖或描述搜尋團隊內設計資產的智慧搜尋。文章也誠實列出現階段限制，適合想快速掌握 Figma AI 全貌、評估是否該調整工作流程的設計師與 PM 參考。
articles.summary_en: This roundup maps Figma AI's full 2026 feature set: text-to-layout generation, context-aware component suggestions, automatic design-system cleanup, image editing like background removal and expansion, and smart search across team assets using a screenshot or description. It also lays out current limitations honestly, making it a useful gut-check for designers and PMs deciding whether to rework their workflow.
articles.take_zh: 把散落的 AI 功能整理成一張全貌圖很有價值，看完能更清楚哪些環節值得現在就導入，哪些還是先觀望比較好。
articles.take_en: Mapping scattered AI features into one clear picture is genuinely useful — it makes obvious which parts are worth adopting now versus still worth waiting on.

articles.title_zh: Figma Agent 進入 Beta：可串接 GitHub、Slack 取用專案脈絡
articles.title_en: Figma's Agent Enters Beta, Connects to GitHub and Slack for Context
articles.summary_zh: Figma 官方說明其 Agent 功能已進入公開測試，作為取代 First Draft 的新入口。Agent 能參照團隊既有檔案理解並延續設計規範，也能上網抓取即時資料，並透過 MCP 連接 GitHub、Atlassian、Slack 等工具，把跨工具的專案脈絡直接帶進設計檔案中，減少來回切換視窗的時間成本。
articles.summary_en: Figma's official help docs confirm its Agent feature is now in public beta, replacing First Draft as the new AI entry point. The Agent can reference a team's existing files to understand and continue established design patterns, pull live data from the web, and connect to tools like GitHub, Atlassian, and Slack via MCP — bringing cross-tool project context straight into the design file and cutting down window-switching.
articles.take_zh: 把 GitHub、Slack 的脈絡直接接進設計檔案，等於把「開會同步狀態」這件事外包給 AI，值得團隊盡早排進 beta 測試名單。
articles.take_en: Piping GitHub and Slack context straight into the design file effectively outsources status-sync meetings to AI — worth getting your team into the beta queue early.
